SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, P.PROJNO, P.PROJNAME, P.TESTORGNAME, P.BIZCATEGORYID, B.PROPERTYTMPLID AS TMPLID, P.BIZCATEGORYCODE, C.REPORTNAME FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT P ON P.ID = A.PROJID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY E ON P.BIZCATEGORYCODE = E.BIZCATEGORYID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_TMPL B ON B.ID = A.MONITORTMPLID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_REPORT_CONFIG_LINE C ON C.ID = A.REPORTCONFIGLINEID) T
AND
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FOLDER B ON A.FOLDERID = B.ID WHERE A.SAMPLEID = T.ID
AND B.SCENEUSERID = #{sceneUserId}
AND B.SCENEUSERNAME = #{sceneUserName}
AND INSTR( ',' || B.SAMPLEUSERNAME || ',',',' || #{sampleUserName} || ',' ) > 0
AND A.SAMPLEBEGINDATE >= #{sampleBeginDate}
AND A.SAMPLECOMPLETEDATE <= #{sampleCompleteDate} )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_REPORT A WHERE A.MONITORTMPLID = T.MONITORTMPLID AND A.PROJID = T.PROJID AND A.STATUS = 'draft')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER R LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O ON O.ORDERID = R.ID WHERE R.SAMPLEID = T.ID AND O.STATUS = 'preLogged' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND R.TERMINATION != '1')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK B ON A.ID = B.ORDERID WHERE A.SAMPLEID = T.ID AND B.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND B.STATUS NOT IN ('draft', 'preLogged', 'done', 'approve', 'audit'))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK B ON A.ID = B.ORDERID WHERE A.SAMPLEID = T.ID AND B.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND B.STATUS NOT IN ('draft', 'preLogged', 'done'))
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, P.PROJNO, P.PROJNAME, P.STATUS AS PROJSTATUS, P.TESTORGNAME, P.BIZCATEGORYID, B.PROPERTYTMPLID AS TMPLID FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT P ON P.ID = A.PROJID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_TMPL B ON B.ID = A.MONITORTMPLID) T
AND
AND STATUS = 'draft' AND PROCESSSTATUS LIKE CONCAT('draft', '%')
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.*, CONCAT(SUMNUMBER, '/', TOTAL) AS NUM FROM (SELECT S.*, COUNT(1) AS TOTAL, IFNULL(SUM(SCANNED), 0) AS SUMNUMBER FROM (SELECT U.* FROM (SELECT A.ID, A.STATUS, A.PROCESSSTATUS, A.SAMPLENO, A.ORDERCATEGORY, B.PROJNO, B.PROJNAME, B.TESTORGNAME, B.BIZCATEGORYID, B. STATUS AS PROJECTSTATUS, (CONCAT(IFNULL(D.CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE, ''), IFNULL(C.ORDERNO, ''), IFNULL(D.CONTAINERGROUP, ''))) AS NUMBER, D.SCANNED
FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT B ON B.ID = A.PROJID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER C ON A.ID = C.SAMPLEID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK D ON C.ID = D.ORDERID WHERE D.CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE IS NOT NULL ) U WHERE U.STATUS = 'preLogged' AND U.PROCESSSTATUS = 'done' AND U.PROJECTSTATUS <> 'cancel' GROUP BY NUMBER) S GROUP BY S.ID) T

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.ID, A.SAMPLENO, A.CREATEDBYNAME, A.REMARK, C.ORDERNO, C.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, C.ORDERDESC, WM_CONCAT(DISTINCT D.TESTNAME) AS TESTNAME, CONCAT(IFNULL(C.ORDERNO, ''), IFNULL(D.CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE, ''), IFNULL(D.CONTAINERGROUP, '')) AS LABELID, CASE D.SCANNED WHEN '1' THEN '已扫描' ELSE '未扫描' END STATUS FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT B ON B.ID = A.PROJID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER C ON A.ID = C.SAMPLEID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK D ON C.ID = D.ORDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FOLDER E ON C.FOLDERID = E.ID WHERE A.ID = #{id} AND D.CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY LABELID) T

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.ID, B.PROJNO, B.PROJNAME, C.ORDERNO, C.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, C.ORDERDESC, E.MONITORPOINTNAME, WM_CONCAT(DISTINCT D.TESTNAME) AS TESTNAME, CONCAT(IFNULL(C.ORDERNO, ''), IFNULL(D.CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE, ''), IFNULL(D.CONTAINERGROUP, '')) AS LABELID FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT B ON B.ID = A.PROJID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER C ON A.ID = C.SAMPLEID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK D ON C.ID = D.ORDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FOLDER E ON C.FOLDERID = E.ID WHERE C.ORDERNO = SUBSTR(#{labelId},1, 13) AND D.CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE IS NOT NULL AND CONCAT(IFNULL(C.ORDERNO, ''), IFNULL(D.CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE, ''), IFNULL(D.CONTAINERGROUP, '')) = #{labelId} GROUP BY LABELID) T
